title: Suspension ride comfort and tuning
summary: Feedback on the G70 suspension centers on ride comfort and tuning, with praise for smoothness, comfort, adjustability, and air suspension, while a few comments mention noises or a softer-than-desired setup.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the suspension for smooth ride quality, comfort, strong cornering adjustment in Sport Mode, and excellent air suspension execution.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention abnormal suspension-related noise when turning out of a driveway into traffic.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe the suspension as softer, looser, or less firm than preferred, but the examples do not clearly establish whether those comments are overall positive or negative.

limitations: The sampled fragments are not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
Several undetermined examples discuss suspension softness or looseness, limiting confidence about overall sentiment for those comments.
The evidence is almost entirely from US G70 reviews, so there is no basis here for broader market or model comparisons.
Only a subset of topic fragments is shown, so some aspects mentioned elsewhere in the topic may be missing.
